messages:
sanjay: quick sync — postmortem follow-ups for friday incident. we keep hitting the same canary regression pattern where a config drift + large rollout hits an untested codepath. want explicit owners and short timelines for auto-rollback + blast-radius limits :spiral_notepad:
kevin: Agreed. I think two tracks: 1) infra guardrails (auto-rollback, sampling caps) 2) process (pre-rollout smoke + verifications).
nina: +1. can we put measurable targets? e.g., auto-rollback on latency/error threshold within 2 minutes, and default flag scope max 5% of users.
sanjay: Love that. Proposed action items: 1) Kevin to draft auto-rollback spec (incl thresholds, backoff, and telemetry hooks) — due Tue EOD. 2) Nina to propose default flag scopes and sampling matrix — due Wed noon. 3) Ops to add a canary dashboard tile for the last-10m error burst metric — due Fri.
kevin: I can take the spec. quick note: need to decide whether rollback is model switch vs feature-flag kill. leaning feature-flag kill for speed.
ops-bot: Reminder: infra ticket template created -> TICK-3482. Claim to assign with `/claim` or add assignee.
nina: draft scope: 1% for global experiments, 5% for region-limited by default. emergency carve-outs for infra-only fixes. adding rationale in doc.
sanjay: For recurring pattern tracking, let's add a column in our postmortem tracker: "was rollout guardrail present?" and a simple taxonomy: config-drift / load-variant / model-behavior. Assign me to add the column and back-populate last 12 incidents.
kevin: I'll add open-source style doc for the rollback flow and include a minimal sequence diagram + pseudocode. sample pseudocode:
```
if error_rate > 0.05 for 2m:
  trigger_flag_kill(scope)
  notify(channel=#incidents)
  escalate on 3 consecutive restarts
```
nina: Also propose automated canary sampling reduction when latency increases: reduce sample by 50% on first trigger, then 90% on second. keeps blast radius smaller while we investigate.
sanjay: Decisions captured: auto-rollback via flag kill, default scope caps (1%/5%), telemetry tile, new tracker column, and owners assigned.
kevin: I'll open a PR for the spec and link TICK-3482. ETA Tue.
ops-bot: TICK-3482 updated: assignees added: kevin, nina. due dates set.
sanjay: can we have a short async check-in next Thursday to confirm rollout of these items? 15m max.
nina: Works for me.
kevin: ok. ping me 10m before. :thumbsup:
sanjay: thanks everyone — adding these to the postmortem follow-ups board now. if anyone wants to split an item, shout here. :eyes:
